title: Version endpoint and build info
description:
Expose binary version, build date, and git SHA via an admin endpoint and a --version flag, so operators and support can always identify exactly what is running.

Why this issue exists:
Operators running multiple instances across a fleet need to know which version each daemon is running. Support needs this for bug reports. Currently there is no version endpoint and no structured build info.

Scope:
- GET /admin/version returns JSON: {version, git_sha, build_date, rust_version}
- Version is read from Cargo.toml at compile time via env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")
- Git SHA and build date are injected at compile time via a build.rs script using git rev-parse HEAD and date -u
- usenet-ipfs-transit --version and usenet-ipfs-reader --version print the same info to stdout
- Include version fields in the startup log line at INFO

Acceptance criteria:
- GET /admin/version returns a non-empty git_sha on a clean build from a git repo
- --version flag exits 0 and prints version, git SHA, and build date
- Version appears in the first INFO log line at startup
